summary: Brütal Legend entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Brütal Legend

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console emulation only for comparison.

primary.why: Brütal Legend launched on PS3/Xbox 360 and later came to PC. The PC version is the cleanest capture route while preserving the action/adventure and stage-battle content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC build. Record storefront, patch, controller, resolution, difficulty, collectible/dragon/statue state, stage battles, multiplayer state if sampled, and whether original console versions were compared.

secondary.why: PC is better for capture, but console route preserves original platform context.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC version with capture/settings flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive campaign content changes the PC primary pick.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record PC build and controller/camera settings; multiplayer availability should be logged if sampled.
